name: Collaborative Business Context Hub
tag: A shared workspace where your team defines its KPIs, data and terms, so every AI tool answers in your language.

scenarios.title: Define our KPIs once
scenarios.ask: Our {teams} teams each measure 'active customer' differently. Agree one set of KPI definitions.
steps: Collector
Gathered {=teams * 3} existing definitions of active customer from reports and dashboards.
Comparer
Showed where they differ: 30-day vs 90-day windows, and whether free users count.
Facilitator
Proposed one definition per KPI with notes, for each team to comment on.
Publisher
Published {kpis} approved KPI definitions that AI tools can read.
followups: How do AI tools use this?
The hub shares definitions with connected assistants, so a question like 'how many active customers?' is answered using your definition.
What if a definition changes later?
Edit it in the hub and every connected tool picks up the new version. The old one is kept in history.

scenarios.title: Map our data sources
scenarios.ask: Document our {sources} data sources so AI tools know which one is the source of truth.
steps: Scanner
Listed {tables} tables and sheets across {sources} sources.
Duplicate finder
Found {=max(1, round(tables * 0.15))} tables holding the same data in two places.
Owner matcher
Asked each team to name an owner and a source of truth.
Publisher
Wrote a plain-English description for every table.
followups: No. It stores descriptions and links, not the data itself.
Who keeps it up to date?
Each table has an owner who gets a reminder when the hub notices the table has changed.

scenarios.title: Glossary for a new hire
scenarios.ask: We hire {hires} people next quarter. Build a glossary of our {terms} internal terms they can ask about.
steps: Collector
Found {terms} terms used in docs and chats, from product names to internal acronyms.
Writer
Drafted a one-line meaning and an example for each.
Reviewer
Sent {=ceil(terms / 20)} batches to the right experts to check.
Assistant
Set up a chat assistant new hires can ask, answering from the glossary.
followups: What if the assistant doesn't know a term?
It says so and sends the question to the term's owner, then adds the answer to the glossary.
Can it work with our current chat tool?
Yes. The assistant can sit in common team chat tools or a web page.
